statement: We mention several open problems: We did not strive to optimize the query time. How far can it be reduced, without substantially increasing the space and preprocessing time, in Theorems 7, 8, 9, and 12? Can the factor k 2 in the query time in these theorems be made linear in k? Or at least subquadratic?
